description: The STARS4Water project deposits its first tier of climate-risk indicators for river-basin management in a public XLSX workbook. The Zenodo description says the indicators are derived from existing sources such as the Copernicus Climate Data Store, projected onto catchments or subcatchments and reduced to a smaller scenario set. Zenodo labels the workbook CC BY 4.0. An integrated water-resource simulation could use the indicators to select or compare climate-stress cases across basins. These are processed summary indicators, not the underlying gridded climate series. The page does not name every indicator, basin, unit, baseline or scenario in the workbook. The XLSX was not opened, so numerical coverage and the suitability of individual columns for a model remain unverified. Upstream Copernicus rights and processing details require separate checks. No related catalogue record explicitly identifies this tier-one STARS4Water workbook.
name: STARS4Water climate indicators - tier 1
notes: G6 item G6-2316. Metadata-only draft. Simulation-use and type tags are reviewer classifications. File contents and software execution were not checked. Unknown maturity does not assert active maintenance.
